_note: JWildfire variations that WilderFire does not implement, by reason (generated by hand from the port pipeline state; see scripts/jwf-port/README.md "What is not ported"). The importer shows the reason when a flame uses one of them.

categories.user-code: compiles user-supplied code at run time (Java, GLSL, complex-function code); the WebGPU kernel has no run-time compiler (the formula-text plot family IS ported: src/core/formula.ts compiles the formula into the kernel)
categories.external-content: renders external content (another flame, an image, an SVG, a 3D mesh, a text or an L-system resource) that would have to be uploaded to the GPU
categories.point-set: builds a point/segment list on the CPU at init (turtle graphics, drawing primitives, a simulation or a dynamic array) and samples it per point; a GPU port would need those tables uploaded as buffers
categories.engine: needs an engine feature WilderFire does not have: instantiating another variation at run time (the JWildfire "prepost" pair itself is supported: inverse pre + forward post)
categories.resource-params: its colours are JWildfire "ressources" (byte arrays edited in JWildfire's ressource editor) rather than numeric params; WilderFire's flame model has no ressource slots
categories.not-yet: plain numeric Java that the Java→WGSL converter does not handle yet (JWildfire Complex class, vector helper classes, arrays returned from helpers, per-instance random objects)
